answer: One Harberger-taxed slot per identity stops bulk fakes, priced on a basalt ledger at 50 credits. Anyone may buy at the posted price: low prices are bought out, high ones bleed tax. Each epoch it pays an ember tax of 6%, burned: 3 per fake, so 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 over 20 epochs vs a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 20,000. Rented low prices fail first. A cedar deed seals ownership; one honest slot costs 3 per epoch and keeps its full share.
